about_the_game:
THE PLANET IS IN DANGER, COMRADES!

Hordes of alien invaders have invaded Earth, destroying everything in their path. The enemy has broken through the surface and is rapidly advancing into the depths—mines, subways, old bunkers, bases, and tunnels. The underground has become a battlefield: dark, cramped, and dangerous.

The military is conducting a series of sweeps—step by step, meter by meter. You are part of this machine. One of the soldiers sent below. The order is simple: clear the sector.

GAME FEATURES

Weapon Customization
You can change the behavior of your weapons with modules. Shoot multiple bullets at once, add effects, pierce through enemies, or make bullets bounce off walls. Experiment and find what works best for you.

Destructible Map
Every block in the level is destructible. Grab a drill and carve your way through, break walls to search for enemies.

Procedural Level Generation
Dungeons are randomly generated. Every playthrough is different—new rooms, routes, and situations that never repeat.
